name: Central Sector of the Imperial Citadel of Thang Long - Hanoi
description: In the heart of Hanoi, this former royal citadel began in 1010 under the Ly dynasty, a statement of Dai Viet independence built over an older 7th-century Chinese fortress. For nearly 13 centuries it was a seat of regional power. Today you can wander excavated foundations at 18 Hoang Dieu, a site where Chinese and Champa influences meet, and see surviving landmarks like the North Gate.
